ownership.quote: Founder/CEO Carl Peterson, Founder/CTO Brian Model. CEO of Thunder Compute, formerly Management Consultant at Bain. CTO of Thunder Compute, formerly Quantitative Developer at Citadel Securities.

stage.quote: Thunder Compute today announced it has raised $13 million in early funding ... The Series A marks a shift from proving the technology on its own cloud toward putting it into the hands of cloud providers and enterprises that already operate GPU infrastructure at scale.
stage.note: Last priced round is a $13M Series A (Aug 2026), preceded by a $500K YC seed (Jul 2024) and further seed funding bringing total to ~$4.5M by early 2026 per the founder.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of founder Carl Peterson's Jan 2026 HN 'Who is hiring' comment stating the company had 'recently closed ~$4.5M of funding' (which itself rolls up the $500K YC seed from Jul 2024 plus additional seed money) plus the $13M Series A reported by SiliconANGLE in Aug 2026; no single source states one combined total.
total_funding_usd.quote: We recently closed ~$4.5M of funding to recruit the world's best low-level talent.

last_round.quote: Thunder Compute today announced it has raised $13 million in early funding to help graphics processing unit cloud providers squeeze out the last erg of compute capacity that sits idle and wasted at the long end of workload cycles.

note: YC S24 company 'Thunder Compute' (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/thunder-compute) matches the provider's domain thundercompute.com and founders Carl Peterson (CEO) / Brian Model (CTO) confirmed via YC page, citybiz, and HN. Raised $500K YC seed (Jul 2024, Atlanta-based at the time), later moved to San Francisco; raised a $13M Series A in Aug 2026 to scale GPU virtualization ('VMware for GPUs') beyond its own cloud into partnerships with other GPU cloud providers/enterprises. No lead investor named for either round in public sources found.
